name: noacg-studio
description: NoaCG Studio's plugins for Claude Code and Codex: make broadcast graphics for NoaCG from a coding agent, check them the way NoaCG does, save them into your NoaCG library, and play them out live from NoaCG Playout.

plugins.name: noacg
plugins.description: Make broadcast graphics for NoaCG Studio and play them out: lower thirds, scoreboards, tickers, bugs, countdowns and full-screen graphics, run live from NoaCG Playout to CasparCG, OBS or vMix, or exported for SPX, H2R or any OGraf renderer. Adds the noacg-graphic skill and the /noacg:graphic command, and runs nothing until a graphic is being made.

plugins.name: noacg-mcp
plugins.description: Optional: the NoaCG CLI as an always-on MCP server - one tool, noacg, that makes, checks and saves broadcast graphics, with a browser kept warm between calls. Install beside noacg when you want the tool in every session; it costs a process and some context in each.
